title: Freestanding paper towel holder 14.4-Inch solid brass countertop stand, Carolina Collection Allied Brass
description:
Add classic, space-saving countertop storage with this freestanding paper towel holder in solid brass. The upright stand keeps a roll ready to use while a weighted base helps keep it stable as you tear sheets—no wall mounting required.

Highlights:
- Freestanding countertop paper towel holder for simple placement and everyday convenience
- Crafted from solid brass for an enduring, traditional look
- Space-saving upright design helps keep counters organized
- Felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches
- Designer finish is built for corrosion-free, rust-free performance

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina Collection (traditional/classic styling)
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Overall size: 6.5-Inch L x 6.5-Inch W x 14.4-Inch H (projection: 6.5-Inch)
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Assembly: Not required
- Included: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors such as Venetian Bronze, Spanish Gold, Lavender, Pink, and Mediterranean Blue

_previous.title: Carolina Collection Counter Top Paper Towel Stand
_previous.description: Elegantly hold your paper towel roll on this classic traditional design paper towel stand. Its design is as functional as it is practical. The roll in the stand sits upright on the counter top allowing for space saving. It has a weight in the base to keep the unit stable as you tear off the sheets.
